# Prompt Guide

## Quick start

```
Run ai-visibility-audit against https://example.com.
```

## Giving useful context

Supply the URL, because site type drives which checks run.

## Structuring a complex request

```
# Instructions
1. Audit.
2. Plan.
```

## Good vs. less-effective prompts

Less effective: `audit me`. More effective: `Run ai-visibility-audit against https://example.com`.

Less effective: `fix it`. More effective: `Turn the P0 findings into tickets`.

## Known limitations

Hydration verification is open and unmerged in PR #104.
